_comment: Seeded DEFAULT price overrides for frontier/preview model ids the deployment serves that AWS has not yet published a Bedrock SKU for (docs/plans/metering-admin-console/03-PRICING-RECONCILIATION.md). The pricing refresher seeds these as source=default-override ONLY when (a) there is no operator override and (b) AWS still publishes no rate. Precedence: operator override > AWS-published > default-override (this file) > bundled map > unpriced. Each rate is a CONSERVATIVE ESTIMATE anchored to the nearest RELEASED tier's public list price and MUST be reviewed against your negotiated Bedrock rates. Rates are USD PER TOKEN (public per-1M list price / 1e6). When AWS publishes an official SKU, aws-published automatically outranks these and the estimate stops being used.
_rate_units: USD per token (per-1M list price divided by 1,000,000)

anthropic.claude-sonnet-5.note: estimate: anchored to Claude Sonnet 4.5 published Bedrock rate ($3/$15 per 1M); update when AWS publishes Sonnet 5

anthropic.claude-opus-4-7.note: estimate: Anthropic Claude Opus public list tier ($15/$75 per 1M); update when AWS publishes an Opus 4.x Bedrock SKU
